disagreements.their_reason: No numerical threshold defines "near-free," so any entity penalty could be relabeled near-free within the one-ratio scope.
Changed exp38 artifact fingerprints would falsify learning by frozen-store update; only a separate experiment fingerprints them.
Any old->old case falsifies "does not keep asserting" the old fact; the matrix contains one.
A derivation that uses labels, or successful transfer on another store pair, would falsify it; the aggregate results rule out neither.
"Parity" has no equivalence margin, allowing any depth-2 gap to be declared close enough after measurement.
Finding any 3-hop training example would falsify the extrapolation claim; the results report accuracy but no training-depth audit.
A persistent asymptotic head gap or an information probe showing irreversible loss would falsify the causal account; a finite curve and grid exclude neither.
A head gap above 0.05 on either of the other claimed populations would falsify it; evidence is supplied for only one.
Different case identities or a changed head could explain the breakage reduction; equal sample counts do not establish the claimed paired frozen-head comparison.
